name: Hierarchical Bounding Box Tree for Empty-Space Skipping
aliases: Accelerated Ray Casting with BVH and Early Termination
Large-Scale Aerosols Visualization via Accelerated Ray Casting
definition: A method for visualizing large-scale aerosols (smoke, fog, dust) by optimizing traditional ray casting to avoid sampling empty spaces and invalid voxels, reducing hardware load and improving speed.
summary: This method accelerates ray casting for large-scale aerosols by using a BVH to skip empty space, avoiding the overhead of octrees or sparse grids.
